a0c81b31: ;
 .;This routine is used to print a report of Discharge Summaries.
 .;The user is prompted for the following options:
 .;  - Sort order (Physician or Service/Specialty)
 .;  - Patient type (Inpatient, Outpatient, or Both)
 .;  - Report content (Patient list, Totals page, or Both)
 .;The report is then generated and printed.
6abfb045: ;If no response or 'P' entered, sort by PHYSICIAN.
87e3a53e: ;If 'S' entered, sort by SERVICE.
4d0f870f: ;If '?' entered, display help for sort order.
e3d4c481: ;If invalid response, display help for sort order.
6a5ea50c: ;If no response or 'B' entered, print Both inpatients and outpatients.
e01e3160: ;If 'I' entered, print Inpatients only. If 'O' entered, print Outpatients only.
84012688: ;If '?' entered, display help for patient type.
5e139787: ;If invalid response, display help for patient type.
db861a50: ;If no response or 'B' entered, print Both patient list and totals page.
df1f05e1: ;If 'P' entered, print Patient list only. If 'T' entered, print Totals page only.
5eba706a: ;If '?' entered, display help for report content.
0ca9ea59: ;If invalid response, display help for report content.
05a03bed: ;If GLOBAL exists, set multiplier for totals page.
ed72bd9c: ;Set variable for sort order (PHY=Physician, SER=Service, QUIT=Invalid).
